world.title: Spain attacks 'selfish' response of some EU countries to Ceuta migrant crossings
world.description: Italy has temporarily suspended the Schengen arrangement with Spain as Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni called scenes in Ceuta "shocking".

world.title: Uefa has 'lost confidence' in Infantino's Fifa leadership
world.description: The governing body of European football says Fifa president Gianni Infantino has "failed to deliver" on promises he made when elected 10 years ago.

world.title: Israeli West Bank settler tells BBC attacks on Palestinians are justified as revenge
world.description: Settler violence against Palestinians is on the rise in the West Bank, as settlements and outposts expand.

world.title: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja killed in Pakistan avalanche, his company says
world.description: The renowned mountaineer was known for scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in just over six months in 2019.

world.title: Nine killed in strikes on Kyiv, as Ukraine sinks Russian container ship
world.description: The attack comes as Moscow escalates deadly ballistic missile attacks on the Ukrainian capital.

world.title: Peru's ex-president leaves jail after 15-year jail term for corruption overturned
world.description: Ollanta Humala had been convicted of money laundering offences alongside his wife in 2025.

world.title: Hundreds escape Greek wildfire by sea as blazes continue across Europe
world.description: Around 500 people, mostly tourists, are evacuated by boat from Agios Vasileios after becoming trapped.

world.title: India's 'cockroach' protesters have wounds consistent with pellet-gun fire, say experts
world.description: Ballistic experts say the dozens of tiny round punctures are tell-tale signs of pellet gun injuries.

world.title: Trump administration drops Reflecting Pool vandalism charge and admits 'botched' repairs
world.description: President Donald Trump had blamed "sick" vandals, and a former Olympian had been charged, but prosecutors now say contractors caused the damage.

world.title: UK rapper Yung Filly found not guilty of raping woman after Australian show
world.description: The YouTuber has been found guilty for two counts of assault over the 2024 incident in Perth.

world.title: Danube's record low levels force shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant
world.description: Romania, Bulgaria and Serbia are also grappling with the effects of a series of prolonged heatwaves and low rainfall.

world.title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
world.description: The missile left a 10m-wide (33ft) crater a short distance from the village of Tarnawa Kolonia, about 100km from the border with Ukraine.

world.title: Father of teen school shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison
world.description: "It is clear you failed as a parent," the judge told Colin Gray, who was found guilty earlier this year on charges stemming from the deadly 2024 school attack.

world.title: Anthropic's Claude AI escapes to hack into three organisations
world.description: It comes just days after rival OpenAI said rogue AI agents had breached other firms' networks.

world.title: Death row inmates desperate to escape execution in Saudi Arabia call the BBC
world.description: Dozens of Ethiopians are awaiting execution - some called the BBC to tell their stories.

US.title: Opinion: Remembering Margo Howard
US.description: Margo Howard had a lot of life experience and used it to offer advice for years as "Dear Prudence" for Slate. She died this week at the age of 86.

US.title: They call it 'a dream fulfilled' -- new homes designed for (and by) slum residents
US.description: It's a bold new experiment and it's already won a prize. Residents in a jam-packed slum, many of them living in one-room tin shacks, help design their apartments in a brand new building.

US.title: FDA weighs a new kind of flu shot based on technology RFK Jr. has questioned
US.description: The FDA is poised to render a decision on Moderna's mRNA-based flu shot, which could be the first of its kind to market. The decision is expected to reverberate throughout the biotech industry.

US.title: More than 25,000 children lose previous legal protections, as federal contract ends
US.description: Thousands of unaccompanied immigrant children are set to lose legal representation. The federal contract that pays for legal access expired Friday.

US.title: Lebanese who fled the Israeli invasion visit to see what's left
US.description: Residents of the ancient town of Nabatiyeh in southern Lebanon have endured wars in the past, but the latest conflict with Israel is testing the limits of their endurance.

US.title: Death toll in Spain border crisis reaches 67 as tens of thousands cross back in to Morocco
US.description: The death toll in Spain's Ceuta border crisis with Morocco has climbed to 67. They included some who drowned and some who were killed in a stampede to cross a breakwater barrier.

US.title: For sale: early access to Trump's Truth Social posts
US.description: The president's media company is offering investors early access to his Truth Social feed for up to $100,000 a month. Experts say the service may violate insider trading laws.

US.title: In the race for Senate in Michigan, multiple party fights are colliding for Democrats
US.description: As Haley Stevens and Abdul El-Sayed vie for the Democratic nomination, voters are debating which way the party should go: establishment or insurgent; progressive or more moderate; new media or old.

US.title: Why did OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI models hack other companies?
US.description: OpenAI and Anthropic say their models broke into other companies' systems during testing, raising security concerns amid a heated debate over how to regulate AI.

US.title: Over 81,000 U.S. soldiers are missing from past wars. One may soon be identified
US.description: In June, the Department of Defense disinterred the remains of an unidentified WWII soldier who had been buried in Sitka, Alaska for decades. Now, they'll try to confirm who he is.
